import MumfordLib.SimplicialCochainGluing
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomology
import Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.QuasiIso

/-!
# Integral simplicial cohomology

The duals of the integral simplicial chain groups form a cochain complex,
and a simplicial map induces restriction on its cohomology. A concrete
cocycle-lifting criterion identifies when a map induces an isomorphism.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- The integral simplicial cochain complex is the dual of simplicial chains. -/
def integralSimplicialCochainComplex (K : SSet) : CochainComplex (ModuleCat ℤ) ℕ :=
  CochainComplex.of (fun n => ModuleCat.of ℤ (IntegralSimplicialCochain K n))
    (fun n => ModuleCat.ofHom (simplicialCochainDifferential K n)) (by
      intro n
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro φ
      exact simplicialCochainDifferential_squared φ)

/-- Integral simplicial cohomology is the homology of the dual complex. -/
abbrev IntegralSimplicialCohomology (K : SSet) (n : ℕ) : ModuleCat ℤ :=
  (integralSimplicialCochainComplex K).homology n

/-- Simplicial cochains recover the existing integral singular complex. -/
theorem integralSimplicialCochainComplex_toSSet (X : TopCat) :
    integralSimplicialCochainComplex (TopCat.toSSet.obj X) =
      integralSingularCochainComplex X := rfl

/-- Restriction along a simplicial map, as a morphism of cochain complexes. -/
def integralSimplicialCochainPullback {K L : SSet} (f : K ⟶ L) :
    integralSimplicialCochainComplex L ⟶ integralSimplicialCochainComplex K :=
  CochainComplex.ofHom (fun n => ModuleCat.ofHom (simplicialCochainPullback f n)) (by
    intro n
    simp only [integralSimplicialCochainComplex, CochainComplex.of_d]
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro φ
    exact (simplicialCochainPullback_differential f φ).symm)

@[simp]
theorem integralSimplicialCochainPullback_f {K L : SSet} (f : K ⟶ L) (n : ℕ) :
    (integralSimplicialCochainPullback f).f n =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (simplicialCochainPullback f n) := rfl

@[simp]
theorem integralSimplicialCochainPullback_id (K : SSet) :
    integralSimplicialCochainPullback (𝟙 K) = 𝟙 _ := by
  apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext
  funext n
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro φ
  change simplicialCochainPullback (𝟙 K) n φ = φ
  simp [simplicialCochainPullback]

@[simp]
theorem integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp {K L M : SSet}
    (f : K ⟶ L) (g : L ⟶ M) :
    integralSimplicialCochainPullback (f ≫ g) =
      integralSimplicialCochainPullback g ≫ integralSimplicialCochainPullback f := by
  apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext
  funext n
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro φ
  exact simplicialCochainPullback_comp f g φ

/-- A simplicial isomorphism induces the contravariant cochain isomorphism. -/
def integralSimplicialCochainIso {K L : SSet} (e : K ≅ L) :
    integralSimplicialCochainComplex L ≅ integralSimplicialCochainComplex K where
  hom := integralSimplicialCochainPullback e.hom
  inv := integralSimplicialCochainPullback e.inv
  hom_inv_id := by rw [← integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp]; simp
  inv_hom_id := by rw [← integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp]; simp

/-- Cohomology transports contravariantly along a simplicial isomorphism. -/
def simplicialCohomologyIso {K L : SSet} (e : K ≅ L) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSimplicialCohomology L n ≅ IntegralSimplicialCohomology K n :=
  (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n).mapIso
    (integralSimplicialCochainIso e)

/-- Lifting cocycles and detecting boundaries makes a map of module short
complexes a quasi-isomorphism. -/
theorem shortComplex_quasiIso_of_cocycle_lift
    {R : Type*} [Ring R] {S₁ S₂ : ShortComplex (ModuleCat R)} (φ : S₁ ⟶ S₂)
    (hlift : ∀ y : S₂.X₂, S₂.g y = 0 →
      ∃ x : S₁.X₂, S₁.g x = 0 ∧ φ.τ₂ x = y)
    (hboundary : ∀ x : S₁.X₂, S₁.g x = 0 →
      (∃ y : S₂.X₁, S₂.f y = φ.τ₂ x) → ∃ z : S₁.X₁, S₁.f z = x) :
    ShortComplex.QuasiIso φ := by
  let F : LinearMap.ker S₁.g.hom →ₗ[R] LinearMap.ker S₂.g.hom :=
    (φ.τ₂.hom.comp (LinearMap.ker S₁.g.hom).subtype).codRestrict _ (fun x => by
      change S₂.g (φ.τ₂ x.1) = 0
      have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom φ.comm₂₃ x.1
      have hx : S₁.g x.1 = 0 := x.2
      simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, hx, map_zero] using h)
  let p := LinearMap.range S₁.moduleCatToCycles
  let q := LinearMap.range S₂.moduleCatToCycles
  have hF : p ≤ q.comap F := by
    rintro x ⟨z, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨φ.τ₁ z, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom φ.comm₁₂ z
  let Q := p.mapQ q F hF
  let γ : ShortComplex.LeftHomologyMapData φ S₁.moduleCatLeftHomologyData
      S₂.moduleCatLeftHomologyData :=
    { φK := ModuleCat.ofHom F
      φH := ModuleCat.ofHom Q
      commi := by ext x; rfl
      commf' := by
        ext z
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom φ.comm₁₂ z).symm
      commπ := by ext x; rfl }
  rw [γ.quasiIso_iff, ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  change Function.Bijective Q
  constructor
  · apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
    apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := p.mkQ_surjective c
    have hFx : F x ∈ q := (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero q).mp hc
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hFx
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hboundary x.1 x.2 ⟨y, congrArg Subtype.val hy⟩
    apply (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero p).mpr
    exact ⟨z, Subtype.ext hz⟩
  · intro c
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := q.mkQ_surjective c
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hlift y.1 y.2
    refine ⟨p.mkQ ⟨x, hx⟩, ?_⟩
    change q.mkQ (F ⟨x, hx⟩) = q.mkQ y
    exact congrArg q.mkQ (Subtype.ext hxy)

end Mumford.Analytic
